item.title: Nvidia unveils new AI chip as tech stocks surge to record high
item.description:
Nvidia on Tuesday unveiled a new artificial intelligence chip for data centres. The launch boosted tech stocks to a record high. Analysts expect strong growth for the company next year.

The post Nvidia unveils chip appeared first on Example.

item.title: Floods kill dozens as heavy rain hits northern region, officials warn of crisis
item.description: Heavy floods killed dozens of people and forced thousands from their homes. Officials warn the crisis could worsen.

item.title: India beat Australia to win cricket World Cup final in Ahmedabad
item.description: India won the cricket World Cup final, beating Australia by six wickets in front of a record crowd.
